title: Module seminar: audit semester, then enrollment
rule: Required to finish coursework: 3 credits.
First semester: take part in the seminar without registering for it.
The following semester: register, then present in class and take part.
why: Coursework cannot be finished without it, and it takes two semesters.
source_quote_ko: 2) 이수 방법: 수강생은 2개 학기를 청강 및 수강해야 3학점 취득 가능함.

updates.text: The presentation in the second semester is given in English.
updates.quote_ko: 두 번째 학기에 '수강신청 및 영어 발표'를 통해 3학점을 취득하게 됨.

updates.text: To audit, apply by email to the teaching assistant of the seminar you choose, by the date in that semester's notice.
updates.quote_ko: 신청방법: 희망 교과목 담당 수업조교 이메일로 신청

updates.text: Take the seminar of the module you belong to.
updates.quote_ko: 본인이 속한 모듈별 석사 및 박사 세미나가 매 학기 개설되니 수료 전 반드시 수강하여야 함.

title: Module seminar: attendance during the audit semester
rule: Miss one session while auditing and you get an F when you take the seminar.
The professor may change the number of absences allowed.
why: One absence while auditing leads to an F when you take the seminar.
trap: One absence is enough.
source_quote_ko: - 단 한 번만 결석하더라도 두 번째 학기 수강 시 F로 평가
key: One absence results in an F

title: Module seminar: matching sub-title at enrollment
rule: The same course name is not enough.
The sub-title and its code must match the seminar you audited.
why: A different sub-title counts as a different seminar.
trap: Several seminars share one course name; the sub-title and its code tell them apart.
source_quote_ko: - 만약 교과목명이 첫 번째 학기에 수강했던 세미나와 동일하더라도 부제명(부제코드)이 다르면 같은 세미나가 아니므로, 두 번째 학기 세미나 수강신청 시 착오 없도록 한다.

title: Module seminar: consecutive audit and enrollment
rule: Audit and enrolment should be in two consecutive semesters.
If that is not possible, you must tell the course assistant.
why: Exceptions must be reported to the course assistant.
source_quote_ko: * 원칙적으로는 2개 학기를 연달아 청강 및 수강해야 하며, 예외 사항 시 반드시 조교에게 알려야 함.

title: Qualification examination: format and pass mark
rule: Held once in March and once in September.
A written exam marked out of 100.
You answer 2 of the 8 subjects.
Pass mark: 60 or higher.
why: Passing the qualification examination is a condition for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 3) 합격판정: 필답고사 점수 60점이상이면 석사학위 논문제출 자격시험에 합격으로 판정한다.

title: Qualification examination: subjects
rule: Circuit theory. Electronic circuits. Electromagnetics. Data structures and algorithms.
Logic design. Basics of programming. Random variables and random processes. Signals and systems.
Choose 2.
why: Shows the subjects you choose from.
source_quote_ko: ① 회로이론, ② 전자회로, ③ 전자기학(전자장), ④ 자료구조 및 알고리즘, ⑤ 논리설계, ⑥ 프로그래밍의 기초, ⑦ 확률변수 및 확률과정, ⑧ 신호 및 시스템 중 2과목 선택

title: Qualification examination: minimum registration
rule: You need at least 2 registered semesters to sit the exam.
why: Sets the earliest semester you can take the exam.
source_quote_ko: 1) 2학기 이상 등록

title: Qualification examination: required ECE credits
rule: Earn 6 or more credits of ECE graduate courses after admission.
Not counted: thesis research, S/U courses, module master's and doctoral seminars in special-lecture format, credits carried over between programs.
why: Without these 6 credits you cannot sit the exam.
trap: Module seminars count toward the 9 ECE credits for completion, but special-lecture module seminars do not count toward these 6.
source_quote_ko: 5) 석사학위논문 제출 자격시험에 응시하려면 석사과정 입학 후 전기·정보공학부의 대학원 교과목 중 6학점 이상을 이수하여야 한다.

title: Safety training for new researchers
rule: Complete the Environmental Safety Institute's safety training.
It must be the new-researcher course.
why: Required to sit the qualification exam.
source_quote_ko: 2) 환경안전원의 안전환경교육 이수(신규교육)

title: Life-respect (suicide prevention) education
rule: Complete the life-respect (suicide prevention) course.
why: Required to sit the qualification exam.
source_quote_ko: 3) 생명존중(자살예방)교육 이수

title: Human rights and gender equality education
rule: Complete the human rights and gender equality course.
why: Required to sit the qualification exam.
source_quote_ko: 4) 인권/성평등 교육 이수

title: English requirement: recognition of admission scores
rule: Automatic pass if your admission score met the mark.
New TEPS 327, old TEPS 601, or TOEFL iBT 96, or higher.
why: The qualification examination has a foreign-language part and a major part.
source_quote_ko: (나) 외국어시험 (입학 시 성적이 아래 합격점 이상이면 자동합격 인정됨) 개정 TEPS 327점 이상 / 기존 TEPS 601점 이상 / TOEFL iBT 96점 이상

title: English requirement: validity of test scores
rule: Only TEPS or TOEFL scores earned within 2 years of submission count.
A score accepted at admission stays valid until you graduate.
why: An old score can be rejected when you apply.
source_quote_ko: 제7조(외국어시험 성적의 유효기간) ① 외국어시험 성적(TEPS 또는 TOEFL)은 제출일로부터 2년 이내에 취득한 성적만 인정한다.

title: Language requirement for international students
rule: International students choose English or Korean for the language test.
If English is your native language, you must choose Korean.
why: Decides which language test applies to you.
source_quote_ko: 가. 외국어시험 과목은 영어 과목으로 한다. 외국인 학생은 영어와 한국어 중 1과목을 선택하되 모국어가 영어인 학생은 반드시 한국어 과목을 선택하여야 한다.

title: Korean language test
rule: Run by the Office of Academic Affairs every March and September.
After failing once, an oral test is possible with your advisor's recommendation.
why: One way to pass the language requirement.
source_quote_ko: 제10조(외국인학생의 한국어시험) ① 외국인학생의 한국어시험은 교무처가 매년 3월과 9월에 주관하여 시행하는 시험으로 한다.

title: Korean language course in place of the test
rule: Take Korean Language and Culture 1 or 2 when it is offered as the substitute for the test, in a regular semester or a seasonal session.
A grade of C- or higher, or S, in that course waives the Korean test.
These credits do not count toward your coursework credits.
why: The other way to pass the language requirement.
trap: The class is extra work on top of your required credits.
source_quote_ko: ③ 정규학기 또는 계절수업에서 논문제출자격시험의 대체과목으로 개설된 한국어 과목(한국어와 한국문화 1 또는 2)을 수강하고, 그 성적이 “C-이상” 또는 “S”의 성적을 취득한 경우에는 한국어시험을 면제하되, 수료학점에는 포함하지 않는다.
key: Grade C- or S; not counted toward completion

title: Course credits and grade average
rule: Earn 24 or more course credits.
Grade average 3.0 or higher, both overall and in major courses, on a 4.3 scale.
why: The base requirement for finishing coursework.
source_quote_ko: (나) 교과학점: 24학점 이상 취득

title: ECE graduate course credits
rule: Take 9 or more credits of ECE graduate courses.
The module seminar counts toward these 9.
why: Part of the 24 credits must be from your own department.
source_quote_ko: (마) 전기·정보공학부 대학원 교과목 9학점 이상 수강 (모듈세미나 포함)

title: Thesis research credit limit
rule: At most 6 thesis research credits count toward coursework.
Anything above 6 is not counted.
why: Extra thesis research credits do not get you to 24.
source_quote_ko: (바) 논문연구 최대 6학점 인정, 그 이상은 수료학점에 불인정

title: Research ethics course
rule: Take at least one of three research ethics courses.
Taken during an SNU master's, it need not be repeated in the PhD.
why: One research ethics course is compulsory.
source_quote_ko: (2) 기초역량 중 “연구윤리 교과목”은 최대 3학점까지만 인정하며, 반드시 한 과목은 필수로 이수해야함.

title: Common-competency course credit limit
rule: At most 3 credits of graduate common-competency courses count.
why: More than 3 such credits do not get you to 24.
source_quote_ko: (사) “대학원 공통역량 교과목” 최대 3학점 인정

title: Undergraduate course credit limit
rule: Up to 6 credits of undergraduate major courses can count.
The major must match. General-education courses are excluded.
why: A limited way to reach 24 credits.
source_quote_ko: (라) 석사과정에서 학사과정 전공교과목을 6학점까지 이수학점으로 인정

title: Other-department course credit limit
rule: If you count 6 thesis research credits, other-department courses count up to 9 credits.
You still need 9 or more ECE graduate credits.
The self-check sheet says the academic board notice on this must be read.
why: Credits above the cap do not get you to 24.
source_quote_ko: 6) 타학과, 학부과목 이수 여부(반드시 학사게시판 게시글 참조)(논문연구 6학점 수강 했으면 타학과 9학점까지만 인정, 주전공 9학점 이상 수강 필수)
key: Up to 9 credits with 6 thesis research credits

title: Recognition of graduate credits from other universities
rule: Credits earned elsewhere before admission can count: up to 6 for master's, 9 for PhD, 15 for integrated.
Grade B0 or higher, within the last 10 years, same or similar subject.
Needs your advisor's recommendation, confirmation that the subject is the same or similar, review by the department committee and the graduate academic committee, and the president's approval.
why: Approved courses are entered in your record as if taken at SNU; their grades are not counted in your average.
source_quote_ko: 가. 본교 석·박사과정 입학 이전에 타교 동일과정 동일·유사 전공의 석·박사과정에서 취득한 교과학점 중 B0 이상이며 10년 이내에 이수한 동일·유사 교과목에 한하여 석사과정 6학점, 박사과정 9학점, 석·박사통합과정 15학점까지 이수학점으로 인정할 수 있다.

title: Number of registered semesters
rule: At least 4 registered semesters, at most 8.
why: Completion requires a number of registrations within this range.
source_quote_ko: (1) 등록 횟수: 4회 이상 8회까지

title: Completion self-check sheet
rule: Consulting the completion self-check sheet on the department website is mandatory when checking the completion requirements.
why: The department marks it as mandatory.
source_quote_ko: (자) 대학원 수료 요건 확인 시 학부 홈페이지 내 “수료 자가 진단 체크리스트” 참고 필수

title: Degree conferral conditions
rule: Pass the qualification exam: language test plus major test.
Meet every coursework requirement.
why: Both are needed before the degree is granted.
source_quote_ko: (1) 석사학위 논문제출 자격시험(외국어+전공)에 합격하고 수료 요건을 만족하는 자

title: Publication requirement
rule: Present 1 or more conference papers, or publish 1 or more journal papers.
Your name must be first among the authors, not counting your advisor.
Your advisor must be a co-author.
why: Listed among the degree conferral requirements.
source_quote_ko: (2) 본인의 이름이 지도교수를 제외한 논문저자 중 첫 번째로 되어 있는 학술대회 논문을 1편 이상 발표하였거나 논문지 논문을 1편 이상 게재하여야 함. 단, 지도교수가 해당 논문의 공동저자로 포함되어야 함.
key: One paper as first author, advisor excluded

updates.text: For students examined from Fall 2026: the paper must be published or have confirmed acceptance. Proof of submission to a journal is no longer accepted.
updates.quote_ko: 논문지 투고를 증명하는 서류는 제출하여도 인정 불가 (종전 인정 지침 폐지)

updates.text: A paper on which you are co-first author is not recognised, even if your name is listed first.
updates.quote_ko: 본인의 이름이 첫 번째로 되어 있어도 공동1저자라면 인정 불가

updates.text: The proof of publication or acceptance must be a document that can be issued before the date for submitting the defense result documents.
updates.quote_ko: 심사 학기의 논문심사 결과서류 제출일자 이전까지 발급 가능한 서류여야 합니다.

updates.text: A conference that accepts only an abstract can count if it has peer review and a preliminary-committee member confirms it by signature.
updates.quote_ko: 풀페이퍼가 아닌 초록(Abstract)만 제출하는 학술대회도 아래 요건 충족 시 인정 가능합니다.

title: Thesis defense schedule
rule: Apply: March to April, or September to October.
Defense: May, or November.
Hand in 3 copies of the thesis 1 to 2 weeks before the defense.
Results due: early June, or early December.
why: Exact dates and forms are announced each semester and may change.

title: Thesis submission deadline
rule: Within 4 years after finishing coursework.
A 2-year extension is possible on request.
If the thesis has still not been examined after the extension, a further period of up to 3 years can be approved once, with added registration and credits.
why: The time allowed for submitting the thesis is limited.
source_quote_ko: - 과정 수료 후 4년 이내

title: Registration and tuition payment
rule: Registration is in February and August.
Exact dates are announced on the SNU and department notice boards.
why: If the instalments are not all paid by the fourth, you are treated as not registered.
source_quote_ko: : 2월, 8월 (세부일정은 서울대 및 학부 홈페이지 주요공지사항 게시판으로 안내)

title: Thesis research confirmation form
rule: Every semester you register for Thesis Research (430.960).
One page: research content, thesis title, at least 3 references, signed by the course professor.
Due at the department office within one week after the add/drop period.
why: Keeps your thesis research grade.
trap: No form means a U grade.
source_quote_ko: 2. 논문연구를 신청하는 매학기 개강 초 수강정정 기간 후 일주일 내에 제출해야 함.

title: Registration beyond the standard semesters
rule: From semester 5 for master's and PhD, semester 9 for integrated, tuition depends on the credits you take.
Registering for 0 credits means removal for non-registration.
why: The handbook states removal for non-registration in this case.
trap: Zero credits is treated as not registered.
source_quote_ko: ※ 규정학기 초과자가 학점 신청 안할 시(0학점인 경우) 미등록 제적

title: Leave of absence
rule: Up to 4 semesters. Military, start-up, illness, pregnancy and childbirth, childcare and recommended leave are not counted in this limit.
One leave request is valid for up to 1 year.
Apply on mySNU. Your advisor approves online after a meeting.
why: Going over the limit means removal from the program.
source_quote_ko: (가) 석사과정: 4개 학기까지 가능

title: Return from leave of absence
rule: Apply within the set period: mid December or mid June.
Apply on mySNU, then register in the registration period.
why: Return is possible only within the designated registration period.
source_quote_ko: (1) 시기: 지정된 등록 기간 내 (12월 중순, 6월 중순)

title: Module seminar: audit semester, then enrollment
rule: Required to finish coursework: the doctoral module seminar, 3 credits.
First semester: audit only, without registering.
Next semester: register, then present in class.
why: Coursework cannot be finished without it, and it takes two semesters.
source_quote_ko: (가) 필수교과목: 모듈별 박사세미나 3학점 필수(2009 후기입학생부터 적용) (내규)

title: Module seminars: master's and doctoral
rule: Both the master's and the doctoral module seminar are required: 6 credits in total.
Each one: audit a semester, then register and present the next.
Start the doctoral seminar from semester 4, after finishing the master's seminar.
why: Four semesters of seminar in all, so the order matters.
source_quote_ko: * 석사세미나를 2개 학기에 걸쳐 청강 및 수강한 후 4학기부터 박사세미나를 청강 및 수강해야 한다. (2012 학번 부터 적용)

title: Continuation or withdrawal form
rule: Hand in either the continue form or the give-up form at the end of semester 2.
After a continue form you can still switch to give-up, until one semester before finishing coursework.
After a give-up form you cannot switch back.
why: It must be on file before the exam in semester 3.
trap: Giving up is final.
source_quote_ko: (1) 논자시 필수 응시학기인 셋째학기 이전인 둘째학기 말에 석박통합과정 포기원 혹은 지속원 둘 중 하나를 선택해 필수 제출
key: Due at the end of semester 2

A written exam marked out of 100.
You answer 2 of the 8 subjects.
Pass mark: 70 or higher.

title: Qualification examination: required ECE credits
rule: Earn 6 or more credits of ECE graduate courses after entering the integrated program.

why: Without these 6 credits you cannot sit the exam.

title: Qualification examination: timing and attempt limit
rule: You must sit the exam at the start of your third semester.
The number of attempts is limited to one.
why: The handbook fixes both the timing and the number of attempts.
trap: There is no free second attempt.
source_quote_ko: 1) 셋째 학기 초에 응시하여야 하며 응시횟수는 1회로 제한함.

title: Qualification examination: re-examination by petition
rule: Your advisor must file a petition that semester showing your excellence.
If the committee approves, up to 2 retakes in following semesters.
One refusal by the committee ends the right to retake.
why: Tells you what happens after a failed attempt.
source_quote_ko: 불합격 시, 지도교수가 학생의 우수성을 입증하는 청원서를 해당학기에 학사위원회에 제출하여 심의를 통과하는 것을 전제로, 최대 2회의 다음 학기 재응시가 가능하나, 심의에서 한번이라도 거절된 경우에는 재응시가 불가하다.(2024학년도 2학기부터 적용)

title: Course credits and grade average
rule: Earn 36 or more course credits.
Grade average 3.0 or higher, both overall and in major courses, on a 4.3 scale.
why: The base requirement for finishing coursework.
source_quote_ko: (나) 교과학점: 36학점 이상 취득

title: ECE graduate course credits
rule: Take 12 or more credits of ECE graduate courses.
The module seminar counts toward these 12.
why: Part of the 36 credits must be from your own department.
source_quote_ko: (마) 전기·정보공학부 대학원 교과목 12학점 이상 수강 (모듈세미나 포함)

title: Thesis research credit limit
rule: At most 12 thesis research credits count toward coursework.
Anything above 12 is not counted.
why: Extra thesis research credits do not get you to 36.
source_quote_ko: (바) 논문연구 최대 12학점 인정, 그 이상은 수료학점에 불인정

title: Common-competency course credit limit
rule: At most 3 credits of graduate common-competency courses count.
why: More than 3 such credits do not get you to 36.
source_quote_ko: (사) “대학원 공통역량 교과목” 최대 3학점 인정

title: Undergraduate course credit limit
rule: Up to 6 credits of undergraduate major courses can count.
The major must match. General-education courses are excluded.
The department's completion self-check sheet adds that the 6 is a total across graduate programs, so check what was used in the master's.
why: A limited way to reach 36 credits.
trap: According to the self-check sheet, undergraduate credits used during a master's count against these 6.
source_quote_ko: (라) 박사과정에서 학사과정 전공교과목을 6학점까지 이수학점으로 인정

title: Courses repeated from an SNU master's program
rule: A course taken in an SNU master's and taken again in the PhD is not counted.
The same course appears on the transcript without a retake mark.
why: Uncounted credits can leave you short at the final check.
trap: The handbook asks for particular care not to end up short of credits because of this.
source_quote_ko: (아) 중복 교과목 수강 불인정(석사-박사 과목 중복이수)

title: Recognition of surplus master's credits
rule: Master's credits earned beyond that program's requirement can count toward the PhD, up to 12.
Only courses with grade B0 or higher. S/U courses cannot be used.
They do not count toward the exam's 6 credits.
why: Recognised credits count toward PhD completion.
source_quote_ko: 수료 기준학점을 초과하여 취득한 학점에 대하여 12학점까지 박사과정 수료학점으로 인정할 수 있음.

title: Other-department course credit limit
rule: If you count 12 thesis research credits, other-department courses count up to 12 credits.
You still need 12 or more ECE graduate credits.

why: Credits above the cap do not get you to 36.

key: Up to 12 credits with 12 thesis research credits

rule: At least 4 registered semesters, at most 12.
why: Completion requires a number of registrations within this range.
source_quote_ko: (1) 등록 횟수: 4회 이상 12회까지

title: Course credits and grade average
rule: Earn 60 or more course credits, including those from the master's stage.
Grade average 3.0 or higher, both overall and in major courses, on a 4.3 scale.
why: The base requirement for finishing coursework.
source_quote_ko: (나) 교과학점: 60학점 이상 (석사과정 취득학점 포함)

title: ECE graduate course credits
rule: Take 21 or more credits of ECE graduate courses.
The module seminars count toward these 21.
why: A minimum number of credits must come from ECE graduate courses.
source_quote_ko: (바) 전기·정보공학부 대학원 교과목 21학점 이상 수강 (모듈세미나 포함)

title: Thesis research credit limit
rule: At most 18 thesis research credits count toward coursework.
Anything above 18 is not counted.
why: Thesis research credits above the limit are not counted for completion.
source_quote_ko: (사) 논문연구 최대 18학점 인정, 그 이상은 수료학점에 불인정

title: Common-competency course credit limit
rule: At most 6 credits of graduate common-competency courses count.
why: Credits above the limit are not counted for completion.
source_quote_ko: (아) “대학원 공통역량 교과목” 최대 6학점 인정 (단, 대학원 공통역량 교과목 中 “연구윤리 교과목” 은 반드시 이수해야함) (18페이지 참고) (내규)

title: Undergraduate course credit limit
rule: Up to 6 credits of undergraduate major courses can count.
The major must match. General-education courses are excluded.
why: A limited way to reach 60 credits.
source_quote_ko: (라) 석·박사 과정에서 학사과정 전공교과목을 6학점까지 이수학점으로 인정

title: Other-department course credit limit
rule: If you count 18 thesis research credits, other-department courses count up to 21 credits.
You still need 21 or more ECE graduate credits.
The self-check sheet says the academic board notice on this must be read.
why: Credits above the cap do not get you to 60.
source_quote_ko: 7) 타학과, 학부과목 이수여부(반드시 학사게시판 게시글 참조)(논문연구 18학점 수강 했으면 타학과 21학점까지만 인정, 주전공 21학점 이상 수강 필수)
key: Up to 21 credits with 18 thesis research credits

title: Number of registered semesters
rule: At least 6 registered semesters, at most 16.
why: Completion requires a number of registrations within this range.
source_quote_ko: (1) 등록 횟수: 6회 이상 16회까지

title: Start of the doctoral stage
rule: The start of semester 4 is treated as the start of the PhD stage.
Condition: registered through semester 3 with 24 credits taken.
why: Fixes the point from which the program treats you as a doctoral student.
source_quote_ko: * 4학기 시작 시점을 박사과정으로 인정 (3학기까지 등록, 24학점 수강 시)

title: Degree conferral conditions
rule: Pass the doctoral qualification exam: language test plus major test.
Meet every coursework requirement.
why: Both are needed before the degree is granted.
source_quote_ko: (1) 박사학위 논문제출 자격시험(외국어+전공)에 합격하고 수료 요건을 만족하는 자

title: Publication requirements
rule: One or more papers in an internationally recognised journal of SCI(E) level.
Entrants from 2008 also need one of: an international conference paper, a domestic journal paper, or a registered international patent.
Your advisor must be a co-author.
Your name must be first among the authors, not counting your advisor.
why: Listed among the degree conferral requirements.
source_quote_ko: (2) 아래의 ①항과 ②항, 두 가지 조건 모두 만족해야 하며 지도교수의 이름이 공동저자로 포함되고, 본인의 이름이 지도교수를 제외한 저자 중 첫 번째로 되어 있는 논문 혹은 특허만 인정됨.
key: SCI(E) journal paper plus one more (entrants from 2008)

updates.text: For students examined from Fall 2026: each paper must be published or have confirmed acceptance.
updates.quote_ko: (1항) 국제적으로 인정되는 논문지(SCI(E)급)에 1편 이상의 논문을 게재 또는 게재확정

updates.text: The proof of publication or acceptance must be a document that can be issued before the date for submitting the defense result documents.
updates.quote_ko: 심사 학기의 논문심사 결과서류 제출일자 이전까지 발급 가능한 서류여야 합니다.

updates.text: A conference that accepts only an abstract can count if it has peer review and a preliminary-committee member confirms it by signature.
updates.quote_ko: 풀페이퍼가 아닌 초록(Abstract)만 제출하는 학술대회도 아래 요건 충족 시 인정 가능합니다.

title: Preliminary defense
rule: The preliminary defense is held in the semester before the thesis defense (first and final review).
why: It has to be completed a semester ahead of the defense.
source_quote_ko: (1) 예비심사: 논문심사(초심+종심) 이전 학기에 실시

title: Defense documents and submission periods
rule: Committee appointment report: April for a February degree, the previous October for an August degree.
Thesis supervision report and international journal publication proof: June to the end of July for a February degree; the previous December to the end of January for an August degree.
Defense application: September-October, or March-April.
Defense results: early January, or early July.
why: The first three documents are due by the semester before the defense; the application and result documents belong to the defense semester.
source_quote_ko: * 논문심사를 받고자 하는 학기의 전 학기까지는 위와 같이 1~3번 서류를 해당 기간에 맞추어 학부행정실로 제출하시기 바랍니다.

title: Thesis defense schedule
rule: Apply: March to April, or September to October.
Defense: May, or November.
Give 5 copies of the thesis to the committee members 1 to 2 weeks before.
Results due: end of June, or end of December.
why: Exact dates and forms are announced each semester and may change.

title: Thesis submission deadline
rule: Within 6 years after finishing coursework.
A 2-year extension is possible on request.
If the thesis has still not been examined after the extension, a further period of up to 3 years can be approved once, with added registration and credits.
why: The time allowed for submitting the thesis is limited.
source_quote_ko: - 과정 수료 후 6년 이내

title: Conferral of a master's degree in place of the PhD
rule: In principle the integrated program awards only a PhD.
To receive a master's, you must first give up the integrated PhD.
After receiving the master's, the integrated PhD can no longer be awarded.
The master's thesis is then due within 4 years of finishing coursework, with a 2-year extension possible.
why: Explains the exit route and that it cannot be undone.
trap: This choice is final.
source_quote_ko: ② 석·박사통합과정 수료자가 석사학위를 취득하고자 하는 경우는, 해당 통합과정 박사학위를 포기한 후에 석사학위 신청이 가능하며, 박사학위 포기원을 소속 학과(부)장에게 제출하여야 함

title: Leave of absence
rule: Up to 6 semesters. Military, start-up, illness, pregnancy and childbirth, childcare and recommended leave are not counted in this limit.
One leave request is valid for up to 1 year.
Apply on mySNU. Your advisor approves online after a meeting.
why: Going over the limit means removal from the program.
source_quote_ko: (나) 박사과정: 6개 학기까지 가능

title: Leave of absence
rule: Up to 8 semesters. Military, start-up, illness, pregnancy and childbirth, childcare and recommended leave are not counted in this limit.
One leave request is valid for up to 1 year.
Apply on mySNU. Your advisor approves online after a meeting.
why: Going over the limit means removal from the program.
source_quote_ko: (다) 석박통합과정: 8개 학기까지 가능

title: Life-respect (suicide prevention) education
rule: Complete the College of Engineering's life-respect (suicide prevention) education while enrolled in the first year.
why: Stated as a requirement for all entrants since 2016.
source_quote_ko: ①2016학번 부터는 공대에서 제공하는 『생명존중(자살예방)교육』을 1학년 재학 중에 이수하여야 함

title: Prerequisites of required major courses
rule: Basic Electromagnetics and Practice (430.202B): Physics 2 and Engineering Mathematics 2 first.
Basic Circuit Theory and Lab (430.213A): Physics 2 and Engineering Mathematics 1 first.
Basic Electronic Circuits and Lab (430.207B): 430.202B and 430.213A first.
Signals and Systems (430.306): Engineering Mathematics 1 first.
Programming Methodology (430.211): Computer Concepts and Practice first.
why: These courses cannot be taken before their prerequisites.
trap: Basic Electronic Circuits and Lab requires two courses that have prerequisites of their own.

title: Recommended timing of foundation courses
rule: Computer Concepts and Practice: recommended in year 1, semester 1.
Engineering Mathematics 1: recommended in year 1, semester 2.
Engineering Mathematics 2: recommended in year 2, semester 1.
why: These courses are prerequisites of required major courses.
source_quote_ko: 1학년 1학기 이수 권장

title: English course placement by TEPS score
key: Depends on the New TEPS score
rule: New TEPS 453 to 525: take Advanced English.
New TEPS 387 to 452: take College English 2.
New TEPS 268 to 386: take College English 1.
New TEPS 267 or below: take Basic English, then College English 1.
New TEPS 526 or above: Advanced English is not required.
why: Determines which English course may be taken.
trap: English courses may not be taken in reverse order.
source_quote_ko: ③개정TEPS 268-386점은 대학영어1 수강해야 하며 기초영어 이수자는 TEPS성적 없이도 대학영어1 수강 가능

title: English course placement by TEPS score
key: Depends on the New TEPS score
rule: New TEPS 453 to 525: take Advanced English.
New TEPS 387 to 452: take College English 2.
New TEPS 298 to 386: take College English 1.
New TEPS 297 or below: take Basic English, then College English 1.
New TEPS 526 or above: Advanced English is not required.
why: Determines which English course may be taken.
trap: English courses may not be taken in reverse order.
source_quote_ko: ③개정TEPS 298-386점은 대학영어1 수강해야 하며 기초영어 이수자는 TEPS성적 없이도 대학영어1 수강 가능

title: General education credits
rule: 53 or more general-education credits in total.
Foundations of Scholarship (학문의 기초): 41 credits.
Keys of Intellect (지성의 열쇠): 9 credits, 3 from each of three areas.
Veritas (베리타스): 3 credits or more.
why: Part of the 130 credits required for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 계 53학점 이상

title: General education credits
rule: 53 or more general-education credits in total.
Foundations of Scholarship (학문의 기초): 41 credits.
Worlds of Knowledge (학문의 세계): 12 credits from at least 4 of the 5 areas.
why: Part of the 130 credits required for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 인간과사회)중 4개 영역 이상에서 12학점이수

title: General education credits
rule: 53 or more general-education credits in total.
Foundations of Scholarship (학문의 기초): 41 credits.
Worlds of Knowledge (학문의 세계): 12 credits from at least 3 of the 5 areas.
why: Part of the 130 credits required for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 인간과사회)중 3개 영역 이상에서 12학점이수

title: Foundations of Scholarship courses
rule: College Writing 1 and College Writing 2: Science and Technology Writing (2 credits each).
Two foreign-language courses (3 credits each).
Mathematics 1 and 2 with practice (3 each); Physics 1 and 2 with labs (4 each).
Two further basic science courses with labs (4 credits each).
Computer Concepts and Practice, Engineering Mathematics 1 and 2 (3 credits each).
why: The audit card lists these 41 credits course by course.
trap: Advanced Mathematics and Advanced Physics may be taken in place of the standard courses.
source_quote_ko: 학문의 기초 41학점

title: English course requirement
rule: Students whose New TEPS score at admission is 525 or below must complete one English course.
why: Counts toward the two foreign-language courses.
source_quote_ko: 입학시 개정템스 525점 이하인 학생은 영어 1과목 필수 이수

title: Basic science courses and labs
rule: A basic science course must be taken together with the lab of the same name, in the same semester.
Physics, Basics of Physics 1 and Basics of Physics 2 do not count toward graduation.
If a year-long course and one of its one-semester versions (1 or 2) in the same area are taken at the same time, only one counts.
why: The lab of the same name must be taken in the same semester.
trap: For Chemistry 2, the lab must be Chemistry Lab 2. Chemistry Lab 1 is not accepted.
source_quote_ko: ②물리학, 물리의기본1, 물리의기본2는 졸업학점으로 인정 안됨.

title: Major credits
rule: 63 or more major credits.
Including 32 required credits and 13 or more selective-elective credits.
why: Part of the 130 credits required for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 계 (전필 32학점, 선택전선 13학점 이상 포함하여)63 학점 이상

title: Required major courses
rule: Introduction to Engineering (3); Logic Design and Lab (4); Programming Methodology (4).
Basic Electromagnetics and Practice (4); Basic Circuit Theory and Lab (4); Basic Electronic Circuits and Lab (4).
Signals and Systems (3); Electrical Engineering Design Project (3).
Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 1, 2 and 3 (1 credit each).
why: All are compulsory for the degree.
source_quote_ko: 전필 32학점

title: Selective major electives
rule: 13 or more credits from the 15 designated courses.
Creative Engineering Design (400.018) is compulsory and must be the class offered by ECE.
why: Required within the 63 major credits.
trap: The Creative Engineering Design class of another department does not satisfy this.
source_quote_ko: 15과목중 13학점 이상 이수 (창의공학설계 필수포함)

title: Introduction to Engineering: accepted courses
rule: Introduction courses whose code starts with 400 are accepted, such as those of mechanical, industrial, materials, civil, chemical and energy resources engineering.
Introduction to Computer Engineering is excluded.
why: Fulfils the 3-credit required course.
source_quote_ko: ④공학개론의 경우 기계, 산업, 재료, 건설환경, 화학생물, 에너지자원 등 400으로 시작하는 개론 수업에 대해 수강하는 것을 허용하되 컴퓨터공학개론의 경우 수강 대상 과목에서 제외함

title: Introduction to Engineering: accepted courses
rule: All introduction courses are accepted, such as those of mechanical, industrial, materials, civil, chemical and energy resources engineering.
Introduction to Computer Engineering is excluded.
why: Fulfils the 3-credit required course.
source_quote_ko: ④공학개론의 경우 기계, 산업, 재료, 건설환경, 화학생물, 에너지자원 등 모든 개론 수업에 대해 수강하는 것을 허용하되 컴퓨터공학개론의 경우 수강 대상 과목에서 제외함

title: Major electives from other departments
rule: Major courses of other engineering departments (including Computer Science and Engineering), Natural Sciences and Business count as major electives, up to 9 credits.
Business courses: up to 3 credits, from nine designated courses.
Taking other-department electives is not compulsory.
Confirm with the department which courses are accepted.
why: Credits above the limit do not count as major credits.
source_quote_ko: ①공대 타학과·부(컴퓨터공학부 포함), 자연대, 경영대 전공교과목의 경우 최대 9학점까지 전공선택으로 인정(인정과목 확인은 학부로 문의)

title: Duplicate courses with Computer Science and Engineering
key: Only the ECE course counts as major
rule: Designated ECE and CSE courses have the same content and are treated as duplicates.
If both are taken, only the ECE course counts as a major course.
One CSE course is treated as a general elective; credits of further CSE duplicates are not recognised.
why: Duplicate credits can be lost entirely.
trap: Examples: Logic Design, Programming Methodology, Data Structures, Operating Systems, Computer Organization.
source_quote_ko: 중복 수강시에는 전기·정보공학부 과목만 전공으로 인정하고 컴퓨터공학부 과목은 한 과목만 일선으로 처리하고 나머지 컴퓨터공학부 과목 수강학점은 인정하지 않음

title: Course not counted toward graduation
rule: M2177.005800 (Basic Mathematics and Programming Practice for Machine Learning) is not counted toward this department's graduation credits.
why: Credits from this course do not help reach 130.
source_quote_ko: ⑤“M2177.005800 머신러닝을 위한 기초 수학 및 프로그래밍 연습” 해당 과목은 본 학부의 졸업 이수학점으로 인정하지 않음

title: College of Engineering common courses
rule: College of Engineering common courses count as major electives without a credit limit.
Some of them may not be counted toward this department's graduation credits; ask the department.
why: An additional source of major elective credits.
source_quote_ko: ⑥공대공통교과목은 학점제한 없이 전공선택으로 인정이 가능. 단, 일부 과목의 경우 본 학부의 졸업 이수학점으로 인정하지 않을 수 있으니 학부로 문의

title: Major credits with a second major or minor
rule: With a double, combined or student-designed major in another department: 45 or more major credits.
With a minor or linked major: 48 or more major credits.
Both include 32 required credits and 13 or more selective-elective credits, with Creative Engineering Design.
why: The major credit requirement is lower than the standard 63.
source_quote_ko: ⑥타과 복수·연합·학생설계 전공을 하는 경우 전공 45학점, 부·연계전공을 하는 경우 전공 48학점 이상 이수(전필 32, 선택전선 13 이상(창의공학설계 3 포함))

title: Graduate courses taken as an undergraduate
rule: From year 3, credits earned in master's-level courses can count toward the bachelor's degree, or later toward a master's degree.
To count toward the bachelor's degree: change the course category to major elective.
To count toward a master's degree: 130 credits are still required without those credits.
why: The same credits cannot serve both degrees.
source_quote_ko: 학사과정 3학년 이상의 학생으로서 석사과정의 교과목으로 취득한 학점은 학사과정 졸업(수료)학점에 포함하거나 석사과정 입학 후 석사과정졸업(수료)학점에 포함할 수 있다.

title: Retaking a course
key: Only for a grade of C+ or below
rule: A course can be retaken only if the grade was C+ or below.
The later grade is the one recognised.
why: Sets when a grade can be improved.
source_quote_ko: ④수강 과목의 취득성적이 C+ 이하인 경우에만 재수강이 가능하며 성적은 나중에 취득한 것을 인정

title: Course category and retake corrections
rule: A change of course category or a retake correction takes one week after the request.
Check that the change was made, and contact the department office if it was not.
No change is possible after graduation.
why: The card tells you to confirm that the change was made.
trap: Corrections are not possible after graduation.
source_quote_ko: ⑦교과구분 및 재이수 정정은 신청 후 1주일이 소요되며, 변경이 됐는지 반드시 확인하고 미변경시 학부사무실로 문의. 졸업 후에는 변경 불가

title: Courses taught in a foreign language
rule: Take 3 or more courses taught in a foreign language, including 1 or more major course.
College English 1 and 2 and Advanced English are not counted.
The document marks this item as recommended.
why: Stated in the graduation audit card.
source_quote_ko: ③1과목 이상의 전공교과목을 포함하여 3과목 이상의 외국어 진행강좌를 수강. 단, 2012학번부터는 대학영어1.2, 고급영어 등은 외국어 진행강좌에 포함안됨. (권장)

title: Courses taught in a foreign language
rule: Take 3 or more courses taught in a foreign language, including 1 or more major course.
College English 1 and 2 and Advanced English are not counted.
why: Stated in the graduation audit card.
source_quote_ko: ③1과목 이상의 전공교과목을 포함하여 3과목 이상의 외국어 진행강좌를 수강. 단, 2012학번부터는 대학영어1.2, 고급영어 등은 외국어 진행강좌에 포함안됨.

title: Total credits and grade averages
rule: 130 or more credits.
Grade average 2.0 or higher, both overall and in major courses.
2.0 or higher in each minor, double, combined, linked or student-designed major.
why: The base requirement for the bachelor's degree.
source_quote_ko: ②학사과정의 졸업에 필요한 과정이수 학점은 130학점 이상으로 하며, 전체 교과목의 성적 평점평균이 2.0 이상, 전공 교과목의 성적 평점평균이 2.0 이상이어야 하며, 부전공, 복수전공, 연합전공, 연계전공, 학생설계전공의 성적 평점 평균이 각각 2.0 이상이어야 함.

title: Graduation thesis
rule: A student who has not submitted the graduation thesis is removed from the list of graduates and recorded as having completed coursework only.
Whether the thesis was submitted can be checked on the university library website (library.snu.ac.kr).
why: Without the thesis the degree is not conferred.
trap: All credits may be complete and the degree still withheld.
source_quote_ko: ⑤졸업논문을 제출하지 않았을 경우 졸업자에서 탈락되며 수료자로 처리됨.

title: Graduation audit card
rule: This is the department's graduation audit card (졸업사정 이수과목 확인카드) for one entry year; its course-requirements page has a separate card for each year.
It lists every general-education and major course to be confirmed, including courses planned for the current semester.
It ends with a signed statement that the graduation application is submitted as attached.
why: It is the department's own checklist for your entry year.
source_quote_ko: 위 내용을 숙지하고 첨부와 같이 졸업신청서를 제출합니다.
